reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.comment: Excellent build quality and works great for the price! Paired with an i9 14900k. Install was also super simple. Just make sure you have the backplate firmly pressed against the back of the motherboard when securing the pump. No complaints for my first Lian-li purchase.
reviews.author: Bryce Moore

reviews.title: Not worth the investment and defective.
reviews.comment:
I’m giving it 2 stars due to some biases. But here is my honest review.
Avoid if you can. To begin with, the pump will die between 3-5 years. You are throwing money in the toilet. If you want a cpu cooler that will live the life out of your pc. Get a fan. Dust it every 6 - 12 months. That’s it for maintenance.
For closed loop/pump cpu cooler. It has better performance and less wires. But if you’re on a budget, buy fans.
Secondly. On this model particularly. The wiring is a nightmare and faulty. My wires were defective and the rgb on the pump didn’t turn on at all. Fans are much easier to install. A fan cpu cooler has two steps. I’d describe this at 4 steps.
Just screwing in the pump over the cpu took over an hour. You need to push down very hard for the screws to catch.
I gave a star for the quality of the build and it seemed quiet when I could get it to turn on briefly. The 3 stars I didn’t give it for is that it’s difficult to install with an awful manual, defective parts, and complicated wiring.
Save your money and buy fans.
reviews.author: Jack Bruno

reviews.title: Great for price!
reviews.comment: Use this for my 9700x, keeps it cool and has good airflow with stock fans. Radiator is thicker than most and it not only works well but keeps quiet. The radiator being thicker does make it tricky to fit into some cases but is worth the price!
reviews.author: gerod
